Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in a thin aluminum film bonded to a ceramic substrate after cooling by 180 K.
Use the film CTE alpha_f = 23 × 10⁻⁶ per K.
Use the substrate CTE alpha_s = 8 × 10⁻⁶ per K.
Use the temperature change delta_T = 180 K (cooling).
Apply the thin-film-on-rigid-substrate mismatch strain formula: epsilon = (alpha_f - alpha_s) * delta_T.
Report the resulting strain as a dimensionless number (strain) and also express it in microstrain (× 10⁻⁶) and milli-strain (× 10⁻³).
No material name, film thickness, or substrate thickness is required; assume the substrate is much thicker than the film so the simple mismatch formula applies.
